```{=html}
<link rel="icon" href="/apps/tunes/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">
	<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/shared/abcjs-audio.css">
	
	<style>
		/* two columns when wide (notation left, the panels right; PanelColumns moves panels between them), one when narrow */
		#tunes-root .tn-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(18rem, 26rem); gap: 1.2rem; align-items: start; max-width: 1500px; margin: 0 auto; }
		
		#tunes-root .tn-layout > * { grid-column: auto !important; }   /* Quarto puts page-columns on it */
		#tunes-root .tn-main, #tunes-root .tn-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; }
		#tunes-root .tn-main.pc-empty, #tunes-root .tn-side.pc-empty { min-height: 6rem; }
		@media (max-width: 1000px) { #tunes-root .tn-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
		#tunes-root details.tn-panel { border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #dee2e6); border-radius: 6px; padding: .4rem .7rem; background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); }
		#tunes-root details.tn-panel > summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
		#tunes-root .tn-pick { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; align-items: center; margin: .4rem 0; }
		#tunes-root .tn-pick select { max-width: 100%; }
		#tunes-root .tn-about dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .15rem .8rem; margin: .4rem 0; font-size: .9rem; }
		#tunes-root .tn-about dt { opacity: .7; font-weight: 400; }
		#tunes-root .tn-about dd { margin: 0; }
		#tunes-root .tn-about p { font-size: .9rem; margin: .3rem 0; }
		#tunes-root .tn-note { font-size: .85rem; opacity: .75; }
		.highlight { fill: #0057b7; }
		.abcjs-cursor { stroke: red; stroke-width: 4; }
		#tn-bar label { margin-right: .3rem; font-size: .8rem; opacity: .8; }
		#tn-bar select, .playbar-pop select { max-width: 12rem; }
		#tn-bar input[type=number], .playbar-pop input[type=number] { width: 4.2rem; }
	</style>
	<script>
		const instrumentTranspositions = {
			"Piano": 0, "Flute": 12, "Clarinet": 2, "Alto Sax": 9,
			"Trumpet": 2, "Trombone": 0, "Tuba": -12, "Percussion": 0
		};

		let abc = [];
		let currentTune = 0;

		// options taken off the page (2026-11-11), kept at their old defaults so the code paths stay as they were:
		// chords played by the band, the tune played too, treble clef, the notes lit as they sound, no further MIDI transposition
		const OPT = { accomp: "band", playTune: true, bassClef: false, light: true, midiTranspose: 0 };

		// the ABC editor (abc-editor.js): edits kept in this browser by %%id (else "collection#title"), drawn in place of the site's
		const abcBase = [];
		let abcEd = null, fromEditor = false;
		function tuneKey(t) {
			const m = /^%%id\s+(\S+)/m.exec(t);
			if (m) return m[1];
			return document.getElementById("collection-selector").value + "#" + ((/^T:\s*(.+)$/m.exec(t) || [])[1] || "").trim();
		}
		function editorFor() {
			const box = document.getElementById("tune-abc-edit");
			if (!box || !window.AbcEditor) return;
			if (!abcEd) abcEd = AbcEditor.mount(box, { onApply: function (text) { abc[currentTune] = text; fromEditor = true; setTune(false); fromEditor = false; } });
			abcEd.set(tuneKey(abcBase[currentTune] || ""), abcBase[currentTune] || "");
		}

		function refreshSongbook(someAbc) {
			const tuneBook = new ABCJS.TuneBook(someAbc);
			const selectTune = document.getElementById("tune-selector");
			selectTune.innerHTML = "";
			abc.length = 0; abcBase.length = 0;
			for (let i = 0; i < tuneBook.tunes.length; i++) {
				const option = document.createElement("option");
				option.textContent = tuneBook.tunes[i].title;
				option.value = i;
				abcBase[i] = tuneBook.tunes[i].abc;
				abc.push(window.AbcEditor ? AbcEditor.edited(tuneKey(tuneBook.tunes[i].abc), tuneBook.tunes[i].abc) : tuneBook.tunes[i].abc);
				selectTune.appendChild(option);
			}
			selectTune.selectedIndex = 0;   // deterministic: start at the first tune (no random)
			currentTune = 0;
		}

		function refreshCollection() {
			const collection = document.getElementById("collection-selector").value;
			refreshSongbook(tunesObject[collection]);
			pickTune();
		}

		function load() {
			const selectCollection = document.getElementById("collection-selector");
			for (const key in tunesObject) {
				const option = document.createElement("option");
				option.textContent = key;
				option.value = key;
				selectCollection.appendChild(option);
			}

			// restore the last-viewed tune (so we return where we left off, same key)
			let saved = null; try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tunesLast")); } catch (e) {}
			if (saved && tunesObject[saved.c]) selectCollection.value = saved.c;
			// ?tune=<%%id> (from the Tune Directory and the Recordings panel) opens that tune, wherever it is
			const want = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("tune");
			if (want) for (const key in tunesObject) {
				const at = String(tunesObject[key]).split(/\n(?=X:)/).filter((t) => /^\s*X:/.test(t)).findIndex((t) => new RegExp("^%%id\\s+" + want.replace(/[^\w-]/g, "") + "\\s*$", "m").test(t));
				if (at >= 0) { selectCollection.value = key; saved = { c: key, i: at, t: 0 }; break; }
			}
			refreshSongbook(tunesObject[selectCollection.value]);
			if (saved) {
				const ts = document.getElementById("tune-selector");
				if (saved.i != null && saved.i < ts.options.length) { ts.selectedIndex = saved.i; currentTune = saved.i; }
				if (saved.t != null) document.getElementById("vis-transpose").value = saved.t;
			}

			fillSounds();

			document.querySelector(".next").addEventListener("click", next);

			buildPlayer();
			setTune(false);
		}

		// ---- playback: the band's samples through AbcPlay (apps/shared/abc-play.js), not abcjs's synth ----
		// cur = what the current tune needs to play: its drawn visualObj, its text, the sounding transposition
		let cur = null, playing = null, wantLoop = false;
		// the bar at the foot of the window is a PlayBar (apps/shared/playbar.js): Play, Stop, From bar, Loop, BPM and the four menus
		function buildPlayer() {
			document.getElementById("tp-play").addEventListener("click", () => playing ? stopTune() : playTune());
			document.getElementById("tp-stop").addEventListener("click", stopTune);
			document.getElementById("tp-bpm").addEventListener("change", restartIfPlaying);
			document.getElementById("tp-from").addEventListener("change", restartIfPlaying);
			if (window.PlayBar) PlayBar.attach(document.getElementById("tn-bar"), { stop: document.getElementById("tp-stop"), live: () => !!playing });
		}
		function restartIfPlaying() { if (playing) { stopTune(); playTune(); } }
		function playBtn(on) { const b = document.getElementById("tp-play"); if (b) b.textContent = on ? "■ Stop" : "▶ Play"; }
		function stopTune() { wantLoop = false; if (playing) { const p = playing; playing = null; p.stop(); } playBtn(false); }
		function baseQpm(v) {
			const t = v.metaText && v.metaText.tempo;
			return t && t.bpm ? t.bpm * (t.duration && t.duration[0] ? t.duration[0] * 4 : 1) : 100;
		}
		function playTune() {
			if (!cur || !window.AbcPlay) return;
			const accomp = OPT.accomp;
			const melody = OPT.playTune;
			const band = accomp !== "none" && AbcPlay.hasChords(cur.text);
			if (!melody && !band) return;
			const sound = document.getElementById("mel-instrument").value || "piano";
			const opts = {
				sound: sound,
				qpm: Math.max(20, Math.min(300, +document.getElementById("tp-bpm").value || baseQpm(cur.v))),
				transpose: cur.transpose,
				light: OPT.light,
				fromBar: Math.max(0, (parseInt(document.getElementById("tp-from").value) || 1) - 1),
				onEnd: function () {
					if (playing !== me) return;
					playing = null; playBtn(false);
					if (wantLoop && document.getElementById("tp-loop").checked) playTune();
				}
			};
			if (band) {
				opts.abc = cur.text;
				opts.bandOpts = { melodySound: sound };
				if (accomp === "nodrums") opts.drums = false;
				if (!melody) opts.melody = false;
			}
			stopTune();
			wantLoop = true;
			const me = AbcPlay.play(cur.v, opts);
			playing = me; playBtn(true);
		}
		// clicking a note sounds it and makes its bar the "From bar"
		function tuneClick(abcElem, tuneNumber, classes, analysis, drag, mouseEvent) {
			if (cur && mouseEvent && mouseEvent.target) {
				const k = AbcPlay.barIndex(cur.v.setTiming(), mouseEvent.target.closest(".abcjs-note, .abcjs-rest") || mouseEvent.target);
				if (k >= 0) document.getElementById("tp-from").value = k + 1;
			}
			const notes = abcElem.midiPitches; if (!notes || !window.AbcPlay) return;
			const sound = document.getElementById("mel-instrument").value || "piano";
			AbcPlay.ctx().then((s) => s.ac.resume().then(() => s.bank.load([sound])).then(() => {
				notes.forEach((m) => s.bank.play(sound, { midi: m.pitch, vel: 0.7, dur: 0.6 }, s.ac.currentTime + 0.02, s.out));
			}));
		}
		function fillSounds() {
			const sel = document.getElementById("mel-instrument");
			const fams = [["melody", "Melody instruments"], ["piano", "Keyboards"], ["guitar", "Guitars"]];
			sel.innerHTML = "";
			fams.forEach(([fam, name]) => {
				const g = document.createElement("optgroup"); g.label = name;
				BandSounds.sounds(fam).forEach((s) => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = s.id; o.textContent = s.label; g.appendChild(o); });
				sel.appendChild(g);
			});
			let saved = null; try { saved = localStorage.getItem("tunesSound"); } catch (e) {}
			sel.value = saved && sel.querySelector(`option[value="${saved}"]`) ? saved : "piano";
			sel.addEventListener("change", () => { try { localStorage.setItem("tunesSound", sel.value); } catch (e) {} restartIfPlaying(); });
		}

		// The tunes app steers the shared tonality: publish the SOUNDING key
		// (written K: shifted by the current transpose) — DO from the key signature
		// + resting tone from the mode — and reflect it in the Key dropdown.
		function publishTonality() {
			if (typeof Tonality === "undefined" || !abc[currentTune]) return;
			const m = /^K:\s*(.+)$/m.exec(abc[currentTune]);
			const t = m && Tonality.keyToTonality(m[1]);
			if (!t) return;
			const shift = (((parseInt(document.getElementById("vis-transpose").value) || 0) % 12) + 12) % 12;
			const doPc = (t.do + shift) % 12, restPc = (t.resting + shift) % 12;
			Tonality.setAll(doPc, restPc, t.mode, "tunes");
			try { localStorage.setItem("tuneTonality", JSON.stringify({ do: doPc, resting: restPc, mode: t.mode })); } catch (e) {}
			const ks = document.getElementById("key-select"); if (ks) ks.value = String(restPc);  // dropdown = tonal center
		}

		// Picking a key transposes the current tune so its tonal center (resting
		// tone) becomes the chosen pitch — e.g. a G-minor tune → "D" = D minor.
		function onKeySelect() {
			if (typeof Tonality === "undefined" || !abc[currentTune]) return;
			const m = /^K:\s*(.+)$/m.exec(abc[currentTune]);
			const t = m && Tonality.keyToTonality(m[1]); if (!t) return;
			const target = parseInt(document.getElementById("key-select").value);
			let semis = (((target - t.resting) % 12) + 12) % 12; if (semis > 6) semis -= 12;
			document.getElementById("vis-transpose").value = String(semis);
			setTune(true);
		}

		function saveTunesState() {
			try { localStorage.setItem("tunesLast", JSON.stringify({
				c: document.getElementById("collection-selector").value,
				i: currentTune,
				t: document.getElementById("vis-transpose").value
			})); } catch (e) {}
		}

		// Publish this tune's chord progression (transposed to the sounding key,
		// deduped consecutively) so the chord-sheet builder can autopopulate.
		function publishChords() {
			if (!abc[currentTune]) return;
			const shift = (((parseInt(document.getElementById("vis-transpose").value) || 0) % 12) + 12) % 12;
			const PC = { C:0, D:2, E:4, F:5, G:7, A:9, B:11 };
			const names = []; let re = /"([^"]+)"/g, m;
			while ((m = re.exec(abc[currentTune]))) {
				const raw = m[1]; const mm = /^([A-G])([#b]?)(.*)$/.exec(raw); if (!mm) continue;
				const pc = ((PC[mm[1]] + (mm[2] === "#" ? 1 : mm[2] === "b" ? -1 : 0) + shift) % 12 + 12) % 12;
				const root = (window.Tonality && Tonality.spellPc) ? Tonality.spellPc(pc)
					: ["C","C#","D","D#","E","F","F#","G","G#","A","A#","B"][pc];
				const name = root + mm[3];
				if (names.indexOf(name) === -1) names.push(name);   // each chord once (unique, first-seen order)
			}
			try { localStorage.setItem("tuneChords", JSON.stringify(names)); } catch (e) {}
		}

		// About / notes: what the tune's own ABC header says (T: C: O: S: D: Z: R: M: K: Q: N: %%tags), its collection, and its
		// Works entry if it has one (composer, year, print anthologies); plus the MIDI file. Nothing else is known about a tune.
		function about() {
			const box = document.getElementById("tn-about-body"); if (!box) return;
			const t = abc[currentTune] || "", esc = (x) => String(x).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));
			const all = (f) => (t.match(new RegExp("^" + f + ":\\s*(.+)$", "gm")) || []).map((l) => l.replace(/^\w:\s*/, "").trim());
			const one = (f) => all(f).join("; ");
			const id = (/^%%id\s+(\S+)/m.exec(t) || [])[1], tags = (/^%%tags\s+(.+)$/m.exec(t) || [])[1];
			const w = id && window.Works ? Works.of("tune", id) : null;
			const rows = [["Composer", one("C") || (w && w.composer) || ""], ["Origin", one("O")], ["Source", one("S")], ["Transcribed by", one("Z")],
				["Year", w && Works.year ? Works.year(w) : ""], ["Rhythm", one("R")], ["Meter", one("M")], ["Key", one("K")], ["Tempo", one("Q")],
				["Collection", document.getElementById("collection-selector").value], ["Tags", tags || ""],
				["In print", w && w.in && w.in.print && Works.printLabel ? w.in.print.map(Works.printLabel).join("; ") : ""]].filter((r) => r[1]);
			const notes = all("N").concat(all("D"));
			const q = id && window.TUNE_QUALITY && TUNE_QUALITY[id];
			box.innerHTML = (q ? `<p class="tn-note"><b>⚠ This ABC is probably wrong</b> (predicted by scripts/tune-quality.mjs): ${esc(q.r.join("; "))}. The "Edit the ABC" panel can fix it.</p>` : "") +
				`<dl>${rows.map((r) => `<dt>${r[0]}</dt><dd>${esc(r[1])}</dd>`).join("")}</dl>` +
				(notes.length ? notes.map((n) => `<p>${esc(n)}</p>`).join("") : `<p class="tn-note">No notes with this tune.</p>`) +
				`<p class="tn-note">${id ? `<a href="/practice/tune-directory.html#${encodeURIComponent(w ? w.id : id)}">In the Tune Directory</a> · ` : ""}<span class="tn-midi"></span></p>`;
			try { box.querySelector(".tn-midi").innerHTML = ABCJS.synth.getMidiFile(t); } catch (e) {}   // the MIDI file download (no sound)
		}

		function setTune(userAction) {
			publishTonality();
			publishChords();
			saveTunesState();
			const instAdjust = instrumentTranspositions[document.getElementById("inst-select").value];
			let visualTransposeHalfSteps = parseInt(document.getElementById("vis-transpose").value);
			visualTransposeHalfSteps += parseInt(document.getElementById("vis-octaves").value) * 12;
			visualTransposeHalfSteps += instAdjust;

			let abcString = abc[currentTune].split("\n");
			if (OPT.bassClef) {
				abcString[0] += "\nK: clef=bass";
				visualTransposeHalfSteps -= 12;
			}
			abcString = abcString.join("\n");

			const abcOptions = {
				add_classes: true,
				clickListener: tuneClick,
				responsive: "resize",
				visualTranspose: visualTransposeHalfSteps
			};

			const wasPlaying = !!playing;
			stopTune();
			if (userAction) document.getElementById("tp-from").value = 1;
			if (!fromEditor) editorFor();
			const visualObj = ABCJS.renderAbc("paper", abcString, abcOptions)[0];
			if (window.Works) Works.mount(document.getElementById("tune-works"), "tune", (/^%%id\s+(\S+)/m.exec(abc[currentTune]) || [])[1]);
			const resNone = () => { const n = document.querySelector(".tn-res-none"); if (n) n.hidden = !document.getElementById("tune-works").hidden || !document.getElementById("tune-recsync").hidden; };
			setTimeout(resNone, 0); setTimeout(resNone, 1500);
			if (window.RecSync) RecSync.mountScore(document.getElementById("tune-recsync"), visualObj, "tune", (/^%%id\s+(\S+)/m.exec(abc[currentTune]) || [])[1], { paper: document.getElementById("paper") });

			// sounding transposition from the written notes, as the old synth's midiTranspose was worked out
			let midiTransposeHalfSteps = visualTransposeHalfSteps +
				OPT.midiTranspose;
			if (instAdjust % 12 !== 0) midiTransposeHalfSteps -= instAdjust;
			cur = { v: visualObj, text: abc[currentTune], transpose: midiTransposeHalfSteps };
			const bpm = document.getElementById("tp-bpm");
			if (userAction || !bpm.value) bpm.value = Math.round(baseQpm(visualObj));   // the tune's own Q: (100 when it has none)
			about();
			if (wasPlaying && !userAction) playTune();   // an option changed while playing: carry on with it
		}

		function next() {
			currentTune = (parseInt(currentTune) + 1) % abc.length;
			document.getElementById("tune-selector").value = currentTune;
			setTune(true);
		}

		function pickTune() {
			currentTune = parseInt(document.getElementById("tune-selector").value);
			setTune(true);
		}
	</script>

<div id="tunes-root">
	<div class="tn-layout">
		<div class="tn-main">
			<div id="paper"></div>
		</div>
		<div class="tn-side" role="complementary" aria-label="The tune and what goes with it">
			<details class="tn-panel" id="tn-pick" open>
				<summary>Tune</summary>
				<div class="tn-pick">
					<select id="collection-selector" aria-label="Collection" onchange="refreshCollection()"></select>
					<select id="tune-selector" aria-label="Tune" onchange="pickTune()"></select>
					<button type="button" class="next">Next tune</button>
				</div>
				<p class="tn-note">Click a note to hear it and to play from its bar.</p>
			</details>
			<details class="tn-panel tn-about" id="tn-about">
				<summary>About / notes</summary>
				<div id="tn-about-body"></div>
			</details>
			<details class="tn-panel" id="tn-res" open>
				<summary>Recordings &amp; resources</summary>
				<div id="tune-recsync" hidden></div>
				<div id="tune-works" hidden></div>
				<p class="tn-note tn-res-none">No recording or other resource is linked to this tune yet.</p>
			</details>
			<details class="tn-panel tune-abc-fold" id="tn-edit">
				<summary>Edit the ABC</summary>
				<p class="tn-note">Change the tune and Apply (Ctrl+Enter). Edits stay in this browser and are drawn instead of the site's
				version; Download edits saves them all in one file, which <code>node scripts/apply-abc-edits.mjs &lt;file&gt;</code> writes into the collection.</p>
				<div id="tune-abc-edit"></div>
			</details>
			<button type="button" class="tn-reset-cols btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Put the panels back</button>
		</div>
	</div>
	<input type="hidden" id="vis-transpose" value="0">
	<div id="tn-bar">
		<button type="button" id="tp-play" data-space-play>▶ Play</button>
		<button type="button" id="tp-stop" disabled>■ Stop</button>
		<span data-pri="2" data-pri-live="3"><label for="tp-from">From bar</label><input type="number" id="tp-from" min="1" value="1"></span>
		<span data-pri="3" data-pri-live="4"><input type="checkbox" id="tp-loop"> <label for="tp-loop">Loop</label></span>
		<span data-pri="1" data-pri-live="2"><label for="tp-bpm">BPM</label><input type="number" id="tp-bpm" min="20" max="300" step="2" aria-label="Tempo in beats per minute"></span>
		<span data-pri="4" data-pri-live="5"><label for="key-select">Key</label><select id="key-select" onchange="onKeySelect()">
			<option value="0">C</option><option value="1">Db</option><option value="2">D</option>
			<option value="3">Eb</option><option value="4">E</option><option value="5">F</option>
			<option value="6">Gb</option><option value="7">G</option><option value="8">Ab</option>
			<option value="9">A</option><option value="10">Bb</option><option value="11">B</option>
		</select></span>
		<span data-pri="5" data-pri-live="6"><label for="vis-octaves">Octave</label><select id="vis-octaves" onchange="pickTune()">
			<option value="-2">−2</option><option value="-1">−1</option><option value="0" selected>0</option><option value="1">+1</option><option value="2">+2</option>
		</select></span>
		<span data-pri="6" data-pri-live="7"><label for="inst-select">Instrument</label><select id="inst-select" onchange="pickTune()">
			<option value="Piano">Piano</option><option value="Flute">Flute</option><option value="Clarinet">Clarinet</option>
			<option value="Alto Sax">Alto Sax</option><option value="Trumpet">Trumpet</option><option value="Trombone">Trombone</option>
			<option value="Tuba">Tuba</option><option value="Percussion">Percussion</option>
		</select></span>
		<span data-pri="7" data-pri-live="8"><label for="mel-instrument">Sound</label><select id="mel-instrument" title="Playback instrument"></select></span>
	</div>
	<script src="/apps/shared/soundfont.js?v=1"></script>
	<script src="/apps/shared/playbar.js?v=4"></script>
	<script src="/apps/shared/panel-columns.js"></script>
	<script src="/apps/shared/band/sounds.js?v=23"></script>
	<script src="/apps/shared/abc-play.js?v=27"></script>
	<script src="/apps/shared/abcjs-basic.js?v=5"></script>
	<script src="/apps/tunes/tunes-object.js?v=3"></script>
	<script src="/apps/tunes/tune-quality.js"></script>
	<script src="/apps/shared/works/works-data.js?v=10"></script>
	<script src="/apps/shared/mlt/recordings.js?v=3"></script>
	<script src="/apps/shared/works/works.js?v=18"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/works/justin-link.js?v=1"></script>
	<script src="/apps/shared/rec-sync.js?v=1"></script>
```
